balance.label: Hour balance of the customer
balance.projectScopeHint: You only see the hours of your projects. The customer's overall balance is shown to members who may read hours for the whole customer.

projects.title: Split across projects
projects.empty: This customer has no project yet. Create a project first, then allocate hours to it.

history.capped: Showing the latest {count} entries. Older ones still count towards the balance.

empty.title: No hours added yet
empty.description: This is where you see how many hours the customer bought and how they are split across projects. Add the first hours to allocate them to projects.
empty.readOnlyDescription: This is where you see how many hours the customer bought and how they are split across projects. Members who may manage hours can add them.

hint.touch: Swipe up or down over the number or use the arrows. Minutes move in 15-minute steps.
hint.desktop: Scroll over the number with the mouse wheel or use the arrows. Minutes move in 15-minute steps.
hint.fallback: Use the arrows to adjust the duration. Minutes move in 15-minute steps.

duration.invalid: Enter whole hours and 00, 15, 30 or 45 minutes.

purchaseDialog.title: Add hours
purchaseDialog.description: Every entry is its own line and cannot be changed later. A mistake is balanced with a correction.
purchaseDialog.futureDate: The date must not be in the future.
purchaseDialog.noteHint: Visible to the customer: they read the note in the portal next to the purchase.
purchaseDialog.correctionLimit: You can deduct at most {duration}: hours already allocated to projects must be released first.

allocationDialog.descriptionAllocate: Allocated hours belong to “{project}” and are not available to any other project until you release them again.
allocationDialog.descriptionRelease: Released hours return to the customer's unallocated stock. You can only release what “{project}” has not used yet.

project.title: Hours
project.closedHint: {duration} are still allocated to this project and blocked for other projects.
project.emptyDescription: This is where you see what this project’s time was spent on. Billable entries are deducted from the allocated hours; goodwill leaves the balance unchanged. All entries are visible to the customer.
project.emptyUnallocated: No hours are allocated to this project yet, so a billable entry overdraws it right away.
project.emptyReadOnlyDescription: This is where you see what this project’s time was spent on. Members who may edit hours can book time.
project.loadError: The time entries could not be loaded.

entryDialog.description: Billable time is deducted from the hours allocated to “{project}”. Goodwill leaves the balance unchanged.
entryDialog.futureDate: The date must not be in the future.
entryDialog.descriptionHint: Visible to the customer: they read this text in the portal next to the booked time.
entryDialog.billableHint: The customer sees the work, but it does not count against their hours.
entryDialog.overdrawsBy: Overdraws the project by {duration}. The entry is saved anyway.
entryDialog.goodwillNote: Does not count against the allowance.
entryDialog.conflict: The entry was changed in the meantime. Your input is still here – check it and save again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete time entry?
deleteDialog.description: The entry of {duration} on {date} will be removed. Billable time is credited back to the project; goodwill leaves the balance unchanged. The customer will no longer see the entry.
deleteDialog.conflict: The entry was changed in the meantime. Check the current state and delete again.

task.doneHint: “{name}” is done. Would you like to book time for it?

errors.CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: The customer was not found or you may not manage its hours.
errors.TIME_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: The time entry was not found.
errors.PROJECT_CLOSED: This project is cancelled or archived and takes no more hours.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_FREE_HOURS: That many hours are no longer unallocated. The balance has been updated.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_RELEASABLE_HOURS: The project does not have that many hours left. The balance has been updated.
errors.BELOW_ALLOCATED_HOURS: That many hours cannot be deducted because they are allocated to projects. The balance has been updated.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The entry could not be saved. Please check the fields.
